title: PR #101: ci: bind determinism gate to exact execution SHA
content:
State: open
Merged: False
Draft: False

## Scope

Bind the Determinism Gate to the exact source SHA it is intended to verify.

### Fix

- `pull_request` uses `github.event.pull_request.head.sha`.
- `push: main` uses `github.sha`.
- Every Determinism Gate checkout explicitly uses `DETERMINISM_SHA`.
- Every checkout-based job fails closed unless `git rev-parse HEAD == DETERMINISM_SHA`.
- The log emits `Execution SHA bound: <sha>` after the assertion succeeds.

### Evidence intent

This PR fixes the structural Exact-SHA binding defect discovered while reviewing PR #100. It does not modify PR #100 and does not change the determinism test implementation.

Base: `6018637ebe3d3dab5955024929b8d650e6b08364`
Head: `548220addbbb485ea06a7ddd08aa0b359a4b8c83`
Scope: 1 commit / 1 file.

A green workflow result is not treated as VERIFIED until the job logs demonstrate the exact SHA binding.
